text:
elaine: Quick syncGlobalDocs wants us to onboard 4 locale-heavy models (es/fr/de/ja) and theyare asking for a pinned version for 60-90 days. Need clear onboarding bench slice, canary plan, infra fallback, and migration path so sales/legal can sign.

sarah-pm: Customer SLA ask: p95 token latency <220ms on dedicated, <350ms hosted. Throughput: 8 qps steady, spikes to ~25 qps in bursts. They said 90-day pin with rollback credits is acceptable. Sales wants explicit comms timeline.

mohit: Capacity note keeping pinned full-precision per-tenant implies reserved GPU footprint. Suggest we propose a memory/compute-optimized fallback (v1.1-q4a) and include perf delta thresholds. What delta is acceptable?

nina-se: For bench I propose: 1k samples per locale + 500 legal edge-case prompts. Accuracy + hallucination checks required. I'll generate eval set + scoring script. Quick repro command for bench CI: 

```
rbench run --model redwood/legal-t-7b \
  --cohort globaldocs \
  --locales es,fr,de,ja \
  --samples 1000 \
  --edge 500 \
  --metrics bleu,rouge,hallucination_rate 
```

frank-sre: Ops items: 24h regional canary at 10% traffic, GC drain plan, autoscale window 30s, and alerts (p95 > 300ms OR gpu_util > 80%). If pinned models cause saturation > 75% for >5m route traffic to fallback pool. Also need a rollback playbook + contact list.

elaine: Draft launch criteria (please edit):
1) Bench slice executed, results uploaded to benchboard (perf + accuracy + hallucination sampling).
2) p95 latency <220ms on dedicated and <350ms hosted (measured via real-traffic replay).
3) Accuracy within tolerance: BLEU/ROUGE delta <= 3 pts vs baseline; no critical hallucination failures in spot-check.
4) Canaries passed: 24h regional canary at 10% traffic.
5) Pin contract signed with rollback credits and automatic fallback clause.
6) Comms: Sales notified within 2 business days after successful canary.

sarah-pm: Add migration clause to contract: after pin end customer may opt into extensions in 30-day increments at tiered pricing; otherwise auto-migrate to latest compatible variant with 7-day notice. Sales wants explicit billing delta numbers attached.

mohit: I'll scope capacity delta and prepare fallback perf matrix (latency/throughput/cost) by EOD+4. If q4a adds <=30ms p95 we can mark it acceptable in the contract.

nina-se: Action items I can take: generate eval sets (due EOD +2), add bench CI replay job (due EOD +3). Queued CI job link: https://ci.internal/redwood/bench/globaldocs/1719999988

ci-bot: Canary job scheduled nightly x3 for this bench: https://ci.internal/redwood/bench/globaldocs/1719999988 :eyes:

frank-sre: Owners recap: nina-se (evals + CI), mohit (capacity + fallback perf), frank-sre (infra + rollback), sarah-pm (contracts/comms), elaine (checklist + cutover). Ping me for temporary GPU pool allocation.

elaine: Great. Target to start canary next Wed. I'll assemble the checklist and post to sales/legal once bench results land. Thanks all :thumbsup:
